name: Post-fix chat and tool call
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S2=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--gemma-3-270m-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && S3=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--functiongemma-270m-it/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && printf "Hello\n" | timeout 120 ./core $S2 ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/vocab.bin 2 c ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/bpe.bin 800 950 40 > /tmp/c2.log 2>&1; echo "270M-CHAT=$?"; awk "/chat ready/{f=1} f" /tmp/c2.log | tail -n +3 | head -5 | cut -c1-58; timeout 200 ./core $S3 ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin 2 f ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin < /tmp/tool_official.txt > /tmp/t2.log 2>&1; echo "FC-TOOL=$?"; tail -5 /tmp/t2.log | cut -c1-70'
